used_by: figure E3, figure E4 bottom row, e01_state_decade_temperature.csv, every decadal-change claim in FINDINGS.md

revision_action: replaced by Sample A (minimum qualifying years in every period) and Sample B (identical count in every period)

quantity: state x period temperature level and change

issue: counties with more qualifying years receive more weight; the state estimate is not a median across counties despite the docstring saying 'MEDIANS across qualifying counties'
revision_action: replaced by daily -> annual -> county-period -> state median, one value per county per period, with a bootstrap interval across counties

sample: 'balanced panel' defined on ANNUAL coverage, not monthly

revision_action: equal-county monthly period values on Sample A and B

revision_action: retitled, note added, and a one-value-per-county alternative version produced

formula: last period median minus first period median
